race.title: Conference & Banqueting Facilities At Limerick Racecourse Maiden Hurdle
race.verdict: This looks a weak maiden with preference for POET'S DUKE , who may get away with this trip being on the sharp side fitted with cheekpieces in this company. Western Note has a long absence to overcome but is in top hands, while Con Did It possesses some ability. POET'S DUKE (IRE) WESTERN NOTE (IRE) CON DID IT (IRE)
race.bettingForecast: Poet's Duke (7/4), Con Did It (2/1), Attaho (9/2), Western Note (5/1), Go Loud (8/1), Storm Bresie (10/1), George's Order (16/1), Man Down (16/1), Days Go By (16/1), Awordinyourear (25/1), Aint Over Yet (25/1), Eagle Doll (25/1), Nothingtodowithyou (25/1), Grandioso (33/1), Castle Garden (50/1), Checkpoint Georgie (50/1), Matcho D'agrostis (50/1)
